notes.listings: Seed asking-price data (EUR per m2, existing stock) per city, approximate 2025-H1 market level. Values are hand-curated placeholders — refresh with real feeds via fetch_listings.mjs, which writes listings.json and overrides this file city-by-city.
notes.official: Seed figures anchored to official transaction data: the Gutachterausschüsse (local appraisal committees) publish yearly Immobilienmarktberichte with average purchase prices from the Kaufpreissammlung (the register of all notarized sales). These are approximate values read from the latest public market reports — refresh via fetch_official.mjs, which writes official.json and overrides this file.
notes.trend: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Häuserpreisindex; NRW open data: -0.3% (NRW condo resales, 2023→2024)
